title: dve paccayā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.
groupSub: Reflecting upon and Examining the Dhamma

paras.en: (Mahākoṭṭhika:) “Friend, how many conditions are there for the arising of right view?”

(Sāriputta:) “Friend, there are two conditions for the arising of right view:
the voice of another and wise attention.
These are the two conditions for the arising of right view.”
